summary: RECON_SRC is not a usable source of truth and the plan should use Strategy C: a TypeScript strangler rebuild with a parity harness built first, RECON kept only as a salvage quarry, and Strategy A limited to scripted, asserted bridge patches until cutover. I ran RECON's own OOB flatten logic against the real data in Node and it yields 0 entries (the deployed loader yields 705 keys from 712 raw records). RECON also has no unit renderer or playback loop (Play toggles a flag nothing consumes), and mobile mode renders nothing (recon:src/App.jsx:153). Parity matrix over 62 surfaces: 4 verified, 8 verified with a defect, 1 UI-only stub, 8 different, 9 wrong against real data, 25 missing, 6 dead or decision items; about 65 unassisted developer-days at row midpoints, planned at 30-38 AI-assisted days for parity and 38-50 for parity plus A+ including the parallel sub-page track. Provenance: the deployed main bundle (index-Cg8FAMXN.js, 2,280,438 B, md5 7ef75b95f4) is byte-identical to gettysburg_v21_streetview_fix.zip (Jul 29) and unchanged in every deploy zip from Aug 22 to Sep 29, so RECON was cut from this exact bundle and there is no post-v21 drift in the React code; all newer behavior is in index.html, sw.js, site-nav, data and sub-pages. The name index-Cg8FAMXN.js has been reused for four different byte streams (plus a hand-renamed fifth) while /assets/* is served immutable and the SW is cache-first, which is a live stale-code trap. Version drift: mapbox-gl 2.15.0 in RECON versus 3.24.1 deployed (WebGL 2 mandatory in v3); React 18.3.1 and zustand 4.5.x match. None of RECON's four performance claims is in the deployed build and three are unsound: the SW race is really stale-while-revalidate that can cache errors, the gradient LCP placeholder is excluded from LCP and by stacking analysis sits above #root and is never removed on mobile, and the Google Fonts change targets a font the site never loads; code splitting is directionally right but its numbers came from a partial app on mapbox v2. New root causes found in the deployed bundle: setGoldUnit, clearGoldTrail and drawGoldTrailSegment are called but defined nowhere (C5, and the ?ancestor= mount path throws in useEffect); CanvasRenderer is an undefined global in the sound path; the minimap tick is stale because the store's subscribe takes one argument (H11); the renderer's module-level accumulator i2 makes rendering history-dependent; five clock code paths use two formulas and two date conventions and disagree with the NPS tour subtitles by 35 minutes to 9 hours; Esc leaves pinnedUnitId set so the unit panel never closes; mobile tool sheet has 5 dead controls; dragPan and scrollZoom options are no-ops in Mapbox; Mapbox attribution is disabled on two deployed maps and RECON's; and at least 8 sub-page, embed and share deep links target params the bundle never parses. Also: netlify.toml publish="." would expose committed source; RECON's monuments.json collides with a live 9-entry file of a different schema; OG and PWA screenshots are identical and structurally invalid PNGs. The report contains the full parity matrix, version-drift table, claim verification, decision matrix, phased cutover plan, harness spec, flags and rollback, Astro-based repo layout, tokens, data pipeline, CI, a 34-item trap catalogue, and 46 findings. I did not run a browser or build; items marked analysis only need one confirming run in the parity-harness phase.

findings.title: Adopt Strategy C (TypeScript strangler rebuild); demote RECON to a salvage quarry; keep A only as a scripted bridge
findings.evidence: RECON parity tally (report section 3.8): 4 verified, 8 verified-with-defect, 8 different, 9 wrong, 25 missing of 62 surfaces; running RECON's own OOB flatten on the real data gives 0 entries (deployed logic gives 705; tmp-prov-recon/recon_loader_test.mjs); recon:src has no rAF playback loop and mobile mode renders nothing (recon:src/App.jsx:153). Deployed bundle md5 7ef75b95f4 (2,280,438 B) is frozen since Jul 29; 81% of it is vendored mapbox-gl 3.24.1, so app logic is about 17k readable lines at bundle.pretty.js:96209-113377.
findings.root_cause: No source of truth exists (N1). The only reconstruction is a partial JavaScript port on the wrong mapbox major with wrong data adapters; patching the minified bundle has already produced undefined identifiers in production paths (bundle.pretty.js:96556, 101086).
findings.fix: Record docs/adr/0001-source-of-truth.md. Execute report section 6: Phase 0 archive and byte-identical Git deploy; Phase 1 parity harness before any app code; Phases 2-6 TypeScript rebuild under /next/ behind flags using the deployed bundle as executable spec; Phase 7 Astro sub-pages in parallel; Phase 8 hardening and canary. Freeze RECON under legacy/recon-2026-07-30/ and copy only the salvage list (DistanceTool math, LocationLabels coords, MapLayers ids, HelpModal text, BookmarkPanel markup, monuments and story-marker JSON renamed). Strategy A survives only as the patch runner in finding 40 and is deleted at cutover.
findings.acceptance_test: ADR merged; legacy tag exists; parity harness green legacy-vs-legacy (finding 03) before the first new UI code; at cutover every audit category has an A+ verification test in CI (axe, Lighthouse CI, parity).
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Enables A+ in every category and green Core Web Vitals; removes the maintainability ceiling (Documentation, Reliability, Fit and finish).
findings.correction: Numbers verified (md5 7ef75b95f4, 2,280,438 B; mapbox region 10002-96208 = 81.3%; app region 490,044 B; RECON absorb 0 vs 705). Corrections: tally is 10 wrong (not 9) and P-62 is already among the 6 dead rows; and the premise 'no source exists elsewhere / RECON is the only quarry' is false: Downloads/gettysburg_v2_fixed/src and gettysburg_COMPLETE_FIXED (1)/src (65 files, 8,423 lines, mapbox ^3.2.0, CanvasRenderer/Interpolator/GoldTrailEngine/SoundEngine/NPSTour/FollowAncestor etc.) and FINAL_v24/FIXED_v25 (40 files, manualChunks, validate_data.py, ci.yml) exist. Strategy C direction defensible; salvage list and 38-50 day estimate must be redone.

findings.title: Phase 0: archive all zips, git init a private repo, commit the baseline of record, prove a Git-driven deploy is byte-identical
findings.evidence: 16 gettysburg zips scanned by tmp-prov-recon/zipscan.py (report section 2); deploy zip has five lower-cased assets while deploy:index.html:282 references index-Cg8FAMXN.js; deploy:netlify.toml:1-2 publish = "."; Downloads holds v2..v37 and dozens of variants with no manifest.
findings.root_cause: There is no repo, no lineage record, and the downloadable deploy zip is not redeployable as-is (case sensitivity).
findings.fix: 1) Copy zips to cold storage outside the repo; write ARCHIVE_MANIFEST.tsv (name, mtime, size, sha256, main bundle name and md5, lineage). 2) git init (private). 3) Commit legacy/dist with the five asset names restored to the case referenced by index.html, sw.js and the two chunk imports (index-Cg8FAMXN.js, index-B4G7Z_2G.css, BookmarkPanel-C5YT4b5k.js, HelpModal-CFV9T0zH.js, InterpolationWorker-ufiwa2-e.js); add legacy/analysis/bundle.pretty.js and legacy/recon-2026-07-30/. 4) Tag legacy-2026-09-29. 5) Connect Netlify with publish=legacy/dist and no build. 6) Restrict Mapbox and Google keys by referrer (finding 08). 7) Crawl index.html plus the sw.js precache list and HEAD every asset.
findings.acceptance_test: sha256 of every file served by the Git-driven deploy equals the manifest of the current production deploy; all 119 files return 200 on Netlify (case-sensitive); SW install (cache.addAll) succeeds in a clean profile.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Reliability (redeploy safety), Documentation; unlocks rollback and split testing.
findings.correction: toml:1-2, index.html:282 and lower-cased deploy-zip assets verified. But the Netlify source zip (6aa16d6080...) already has correct-case names, so Phase 0 is 'copy from the source zip and prove md5 equality', not a manual rename. Downloads holds 126 zips, 86 contain index-Cg8FAMXN.js; '16 scanned' understates archive work.

findings.title: Build the parity harness first (data goldens, DOM/ARIA snapshots, visual smoke, intended-diff registry) against a hermetic legacy build
findings.evidence: Legacy exposes no state (store yn at bundle.pretty.js:9361 is not global); legacy rendering is history-dependent (module-level i2 at 96265, never cleared); Mapbox tiles are non-deterministic; legacy app code has zero aria/role attributes (grep of 96209-113377); Lighthouse layout-shift audit shows motion sources (splash swap, #extra-features mover).

findings.acceptance_test: Three consecutive legacy-vs-legacy runs produce zero diffs; deliberately mutating one legacy string fails exactly the expected checkpoints; registry lint rejects entries without an audit id or expiry.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Regression control for every category; prerequisite for safe A+ work.
findings.correction: i2 at 96265, store yn 9361 not global (only window.__gtbgApp 112757), zero aria/role in 96209-113377.

findings.title: Implement one deep-link router; today 8 sub-page and embed links land on the default map and share links do nothing
findings.evidence: Only get("ancestor") exists in the bundle (bundle.pretty.js:101019); sub-pages emit /?tick=N (turning-points.html:118), /?unit=ID&tick=N (regiment.html:247), /?tick=N&vignette=ID (historian.html:110), /index.html?unit=... and ?tick=...&vignette=... (search.html:114,127; embed.html CTA); the app emits ?t&u&z&ll (bundle.pretty.js:97823) and ?ancestor= (101117); RECON emits ?tick&unit and parses nothing.
findings.root_cause: Three deep-link vocabularies were built independently and the consumer side was never written; ?ancestor only works if the panel is already open.
findings.fix: Add lib/deeplink.ts: parse on boot and popstate: tick|t, unit|u, vignette, ancestor (auto-opens the panel), z, lat+lng or ll, layout; validate (tick 1..675, unit exists); apply after data load; write canonical URLs via history.replaceState on share; keep legacy aliases forever. Update sub-page link generators to the canonical vocabulary. Add all eight links plus the share round trip to the parity harness. Optional bridge patch (finding 40) parses tick/unit in legacy now.
findings.acceptance_test: Playwright opens each of the eight links and the share round trip: expected tick label, unit panel and vignette are shown; unknown or out-of-range params degrade to defaults without console errors.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Function and Usability (map deep links), SEO engagement (Turning Points, Historian, Search click-throughs), Reliability.
findings.correction: Only get('ancestor') parsed (101019) is right, but there are 9 links across 8 files, not 8 across 6: also documentary.html:92, education.html:81 and search.html:139 (?lat=&lng=). Add them to the router and harness. ?ancestor= is read only in Zk's mount effect after the panel is opened.

findings.title: Stop reusing filenames for different bytes: enforce content-hash naming and build-only-in-CI
findings.evidence: index-Cg8FAMXN.js appears with four different md5s (a6a94abc9c 2,279,751 B; 150ef117c1 2,280,389 B; 7ef75b95f4 2,280,438 B; b943b2fd9f 2,287,335 B) plus a hand-renamed index-Cg8FAMXN-v36.js (report section 2); deploy:netlify.toml serves /assets/* immutable for a year; deploy:sw.js is cache-first for /assets/; lazy chunks import ./index-Cg8FAMXN.js by name.
findings.root_cause: Previous sessions patched bundles in place and kept the name, which defeats content hashing; immutable caching plus cache-first SW then pins returning users to old code (consistent with the comment at deploy:index.html:259-262 and the reload hack).
findings.fix: Build only in CI from git. scripts/assert-hashed-assets.mjs: every dist/assets filename suffix must equal Vite's content hash; fetch the last production asset-manifest.json and fail if any name repeats with different bytes; generate the SW precache list from the build manifest (no hard-coded names); manualChunks so lazy chunks do not import the entry (finding 19). Keep /assets/* immutable only after this check exists.
findings.acceptance_test: Synthetic test: patching one byte in a built asset without renaming fails CI; a clean build passes; grep of lazy chunks finds no import from ./index-.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Reliability (stale-code incidents), RUM stability; supports P1 recovery.
findings.correction: Understated: 45 distinct byte streams across 86 zips share the name index-Cg8FAMXN.js (28 zips hold 7ef75b95f4, 11 hold 37be334491), not four. Conclusion and fix stand and are stronger.

findings.title: Change netlify.toml from publish="." to a build/publish pair before any source enters the repo
findings.evidence: deploy:netlify.toml:1-2 has [build] publish = "." and no command; only /package.json and /package-lock.json are 404-redirected; RECON README/PENDING say to carry netlify.toml forward unchanged.
findings.root_cause: The publish root is the repo root, so committed source, docs and config would be served publicly (including RECON MapView.jsx with a hard-coded token default).
findings.fix: Set [build] command = "pnpm build", publish = "dist" (or apps/web/dist), NODE_VERSION pinned; keep legacy/dist publish only for Phase 0; add explicit 404 rules for /src/*, /*.md, /vite.config.*, /pnpm-lock.yaml, /tsconfig.json, /.github/*; add a preview probe in CI.
findings.acceptance_test: curl against a deploy preview returns 404 for /src/main.tsx, /README.md, /PENDING.md, /package.json, /pnpm-lock.yaml; only dist contents are reachable.
findings.correction: netlify.toml:1-2 publish='.' verified; the /src/* 404 rules are redundant once publish is a build output dir (the publish dir is the real control).

findings.title: Restrict the Mapbox and Google keys and keep them out of source; add secret scanning before the first commit
findings.evidence: Mapbox pk. token at bundle.pretty.js:97210 and 102899, in 9 static pages (camera, cinematic-export, compare, ground-remembers, immersive, sandbox, unit-rendering-reference, viewshed, watch-together) and as a default in recon:src/components/MapView.jsx:19; Google Maps key at bundle.pretty.js:110610; audit X1 measured a 200 with a foreign Referer.

findings.title: Pin mapbox-gl 3.24.1, guard WebGL 2, and drop no-op map options
findings.evidence: bundle.pretty.js:53873 R = "3.24.1"; RECON pins 2.15.0 (package-lock); Mapbox v3.0.0 release notes: WebGL 2 mandatory, optimizeForTerrain removed; dragPan {inertia, inertiaDeceleration, inertiaMaxSpeed} (97248) and scrollZoom {speed, smooth} (97249) are unread: bundled v3 code reads deceleration/maxSpeed/linearity (88952) and only around (89624); desktop zoom 13.5 vs mobile/RECON 13; three new Map calls (97237, 102981, 110770).

findings.title: Rewrite the data layer to the deployed contract (712 OOB records, lazy days, density files, tolerant fetches)
findings.evidence: iF (bundle.pretty.js:96834-96899) keys by regiment_id/brigade_id/corps_id/division_id/battery_id plus nested battery arrays: 712 raw records (467 regiments, 93 brigades, 31 divisions, 11 corps, 95 batteries, 8 horse artillery, 7 corps-artillery brigade wrappers) give 705 keys (the 7 wrappers are not keyed; their batteries are); zp (96900) merges base + density files by day; aF/lF load day 2 at tick >= 200 (96991) and day 3 at >= 420 (96992); placements: 694 base + 1,110 density records over 188 ticks and 478 unit ids (plc.mjs); RECON absorb() yields 0 entries (recon_loader_test.mjs) and loads only the 9 base files.
findings.root_cause: RECON guessed the loader shape; the deployed loader is the spec.
findings.fix: data/index.ts with zod schemas: loadUnits() returns Map<string, Unit> and asserts id uniqueness (712 raw minus 7 wrapper records = 705 keys) instead of overwriting silently; loadPlacements(day) fetches base plus density and merges deterministically (documented precedence per unit and tick), tolerating per-file failure with a visible notice; commander typed {name, fate, notes?, successor?}; prefetch days 2-3 on idle instead of tick thresholds; single-flight cache. Golden unit tests for the counts above.
findings.acceptance_test: Vitest: unit count (705) and the excluded-wrapper list match the golden; placements per day, ticks and unit ids match; a 404 on one density file yields a notice, not a blank app.
findings.correction: Independent recount: 712 records, 705 keys, 0 collisions; 694+1,110 placements; 188 ticks; 478 ids; RECON 117 ticks/152 units. Nit: eF holds 13 OOB files plus commander_successions.json. See MISSED-4 and MISSED-5.

findings.title: Replace the canvas renderer and stateful interpolation with a pure keyframe engine and Mapbox symbol layers
findings.evidence: Legacy: lS 2D overlay canvas (96506-96688) with per-frame collision spreading (96561-96581) and labels; y1/F4 adjacent-tick lerp (96238-96305); module-level i2 accumulator (96265) never cleared (only references 96271/96279/96291) and mutated from an effect (97324); only 188 of 675 ticks carry records so lerp rarely engages; fF hover popup unreachable (97384); RECON has no renderer. Owner's own reference: deploy:unit-rendering-reference.html (keyframes, binary search, symbol layer, symbol-sort-key, halo layer).
findings.root_cause: The renderer was built on a per-tick snapshot model with hidden global state; correctness depends on navigation history and every frame runs O(n^2) collision math on the main thread.
findings.fix: lib/engine: per-unit sorted keyframes; stateAt(tick, frac) is pure; explicit carry-forward rule (visible from first record until last record + TTL or an explicit withdrawn marker; needs a data decision recorded in the intended-diff registry). Renderer: one GeoJSON source per side updated once per animation frame, symbol layer with icon-rotate from bearing, strength-based icon-size, icon-allow-overlap:false and symbol-sort-key, halo circle layer for engaged units, label layer with zoom expressions, trail line layer, filters as layer filter expressions; picking via queryRenderedFeatures; keyboard-reachable unit list for accessibility.
findings.acceptance_test: Property test: random tick walks produce identical unit sets to a fresh load; at every recorded keyframe (694 + 1,110) engine output equals the record; no long tasks over 50 ms during 8x playback; Day 3 label collisions absent at default zoom.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Performance (INP/TBT), Function, Usability (D3), Historical consistency (no ghost units).
findings.correction: i2 accumulator, y1 in effect (97324), fF wrong props verified. Fix hazard: symbol layers with icon-allow-overlap:false (as in unit-rendering-reference.html:155) hide colliding units, whereas the deployed renderer draws all units and only spreads labels; use icon overlap allowed and collide only text labels or T1 unit-set parity fails on screen. Carry-forward (i2) is today's visibility rule; changing it needs owner sign-off.

findings.title: Single tick-to-clock module driven by a tick-to-timestamp table; remove the +2 date offset and the duplicate formulas
findings.evidence: Clock logic in six places, two formulas (6:00/4:00 base and 5:00 base) and two date conventions (July {day} and July {day+2}): getTickTime 9371; M4 9856; JF 100836 and QF 100998 (5:00 base, July {f+2}); HUD _F 97428 (July {l+2}); RECON store adds 5:00 with July {day+2}. tmp-prov-recon/clocks.mjs: NPS tour tick 264 subtitle July 2, 4:00 PM vs store 7:10 AM; tick 548 July 3, 3:00 PM vs 12:05 PM; tick 12 July 1, 7:30 AM vs 6:55 AM. Only 188 ticks carry data, so ticks are event-indexed, not uniform in wall time.
findings.root_cause: The mapping was invented per component and never tied to the chronology data; a linear 5-minute formula cannot match event-indexed ticks.
findings.fix: data/ticks.json (tick to ISO timestamp) built from chronology_day*.json time fields plus anchors and monotone interpolation, reviewed by a historian; lib/time.ts exports tickToClock, tickToDay, formatClock; every consumer (HUD, toolbar, mobile clock, tooltips, ancestor journey, bookmark labels, daylight tint, tour subtitles, Story and Event cards) uses it; delete all other formulas; lint rule bans arithmetic on day + 2.
findings.acceptance_test: Unit tests: monotone, day boundaries at ticks 1/226/451, every NPS tour stop and story marker time equals tickToClock within 5 minutes; grep gate finds no July {x + 2}; parity registry lists C3/C4 as intended diffs.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Historical/data consistency (C- to A), user trust.
findings.correction: Six clock sites and July+2 verified. Reasoning wrong: '188 populated ticks => event-indexed' conflates placements with the clock. chronology_day*.json declare tick_formula 'Tick 1 = 5:00am, 5 min per tick', 137 events are monotone (0 inversions) and run at exactly 5.0 min/tick for most of days 1-2, drifting to about 3.0 min/tick after tick 340 (tick 360 = 3:20pm, tick 450 = 7:50pm). So ticks.json is right as a piecewise map anchored on chronology; the 6:00/4:00 base in getTickTime is the outlier. NPS subtitles fit history but not the chronology; reconcile them to it.

findings.title: Build one responsive mobile experience instead of the separate pO shell (fixes C1, C2 and 5 dead controls)
findings.evidence: pO (bundle.pretty.js:102914-103700): own map without attribution (102981-102988), own canvas and picking (103008-103103), playRow = 4 round buttons at 52 px + play button 64 px + speed button + tick text in one centered flex row with gap 14 (styles playRow 103813, ctrlBtn 103820, playBtn 103834, speedBtn 103842, tickInfo 103853) = root of the 572 px row; tools sheet has 14 items (103419-103470) but only lo === "legend" (103617) renders (the roster branch at 103505 is unreachable; Roster uses state er); Br("layers") 103442, Br("bookmarks") 103463, Br("help") 103470 have no renderer; NPS Auto Tour (103447) and Monuments (103419) set states nothing reads; RECON renders nothing for mobile (recon:src/App.jsx:153).
findings.root_cause: The mobile shell duplicates the desktop map, renderer and picking, and its controls were sized in fixed pixels without a 320-390 px budget.
findings.fix: One AppShell with layout modes selected by matchMedia (pointer: coarse and width) and persisted as gtbg:layout; shared MapCanvas, engine and panels. Mobile controls: transport row wraps or scrolls with 44x44 targets, tick text above the slider, safe-area insets, bottom sheet above the timeline via the token z-scale, all 14 tools wired (Bookmarks, Help, Layers, NPS Tour, Monuments, layout switch), sheet scrolls when taller than the viewport.
findings.acceptance_test: At 320, 375, 390, 768 and landscape 812x375: getBoundingClientRect of every transport control is inside the viewport; elementFromPoint at the centre of each sheet item returns that item; every sheet item opens a visible panel; axe target-size passes; parity checkpoints pass with C1/C2 in the registry.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Core function (mobile D to A), Usability, Accessibility targets, Performance (single map).

verification_summary: Verified prov-recon against bundle.pretty.js, DEPLOY_DIR, data files, Lighthouse JSONs, Downloads zips and cited web pages. Evidence quality is high: about 60 line anchors and all data counts (712 records, 705 keys, 694+1,110 placements, 188 ticks, 478 ids, 45-way name reuse) reproduced. The defects are root causes and omissions. Five change the plan. (1) Real modular source trees exist in Downloads (gettysburg_v2_fixed and COMPLETE_FIXED, 65 files, mapbox ^3.2.0; FINAL_v24 and FIXED_v25 with manualChunks, tests and CI), so the N1 premise and the RECON-as-quarry choice are wrong; they even hold the "undefined" GoldTrailEngine helpers. (2) The C1/C2 root cause is wrong: the desktop IO timeline and about 12 other desktop overlays are mounted unconditionally over the mobile shell (bundle.pretty.js:113249), so pO's playRow (about 376 px) is not the 572 px row and bridge patch 4 will not fix it. (3) Netlify Split Testing cannot be added to new projects since 2026-08-26, which breaks the canary design. (4) The clock rationale is wrong: the chronology declares 5:00 base at 5 min per tick, is monotone, and only drifts to about 3 min per tick after tick 340. (5) About 73% of mobile CLS comes from event-card and story-panel content driven by the boot fast-forward, not the two sources named. Also corrected: 9 deep links across 8 files, 45 (not 4) byte streams under one filename, missing icon-overlap hazard in the symbol-layer plan, header-override plan that cannot work on Netlify, effort arithmetic, sitemap count 21. The live site was unreachable from this machine, so live-header claims stayed unverified. The Verification section was appended to prov-recon.md.
